## User-facing guidance review

If this PR changes how a person interacts with Provista, review every existing surface that explains or demonstrates that interaction. See `docs/user-facing-change-checklist.md`.

- [ ] Setup wizard / onboarding - updated, or reviewed and still accurate
- [ ] App Tour - updated, or reviewed and still accurate
- [ ] In-app Help / About / contextual copy - updated, or reviewed and still accurate
- [ ] Marketing site copy/screenshots - updated where the changed interaction is represented, or reviewed and still accurate
- [ ] README / product docs - updated where they describe the changed workflow, or reviewed and still accurate
- [ ] Tests - old interaction/guidance assertions updated where applicable

For changes with no user-facing interaction impact, mark this section **Not applicable** and briefly say why.
